title: Warm Springy Vietnamese Chicken Noodles
description: A resinous and springy Vietnamese dish featuring garlic powder and double-fry KFC style chicken, served in a copper mug, this satvik-friendly meal is perfect for a romantic evening.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat to 350 degrees.
Double-fry the chicken by first frying at 325 degrees for 5 minutes, then increasing the heat to 375 degrees for an additional 5 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
In a large pot, bring 4 cups of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, fish sauce, lime juice, and grated ginger to make the sauce.
Add the cooked noodles to the sauce and toss to combine.
Add the double-fried chicken to the noodles and sauce, and toss to combine.
Stir in the garlic powder and sesame oil.
Transfer the noodles to a copper mug and top with chopped scallions.
Garnish with additional scallions and a sprinkle of garlic powder, if desired.
